9573247713512.title: Alkaline Perfume
9573247713512.description:
Alkaline is a unisex oriental-floral perfume that blends freshness, warmth, and soft elegance. It opens with the spicy brightness of pink pepper, balanced with mandarin orange and bergamot for a fresh, citrusy, and uplifting start.

At its heart, lilac, peach, geranium, jasmine, and black currant create a smooth floral-fruity blend. The floral notes add elegance, while peach and black currant bring a soft juicy sweetness.

The fragrance settles into a warm and refined base of patchouli, amber, white musk, and vanilla, leaving a smooth, sensual, and long-lasting trail.

Fresh, floral, and softly warm, Alkaline is designed for both men and women, making it perfect for everyday wear, evening moments, and whenever you want a scent that feels modern, balanced, and memorable.

9546791485672.title: Coco Groove Perfume
9546791485672.description:
Coco Groove is a vibrant unisex fragrance crafted for those who love a scent that feels bold, warm, and effortlessly stylish. Playful yet refined, it opens with a sparkling touch of bergamot, lifted by the spicy warmth of pink pepper and the rich, luxurious character of saffron.

As the fragrance develops, a beautiful floral heart unfolds. Jasmine adds elegance and brightness, rose brings a soft depth, while tonka bean gives the scent a creamy, slightly sweet warmth that feels smooth and addictive.

Modern, expressive, and versatile, Coco Groove is designed for both men and women, making it perfect for everyday wear, evenings out, and moments when you want your fragrance to leave a stylish impression.

Product Notes

    • Top Note: Pink Pepper, Saffron, Bergamot .
    • Middle Note: Jasmine, Tonka Bean, Rose.
    • Base Note: Vetiver, Leather, Amber, Cedarwood, Musk.

Product Description

    • Volume: 100 ml / 3.4 oz.
    • Fragrance Family: Leather

Lasting Hours

Fragrance duration may vary depending on application area and skin type. Typically lasts for 6–8 hours on the skin.

Safety Instructions

  • Avoid the eyes, face, and irritated skin.
  • Keep away from flames and heat.
  • For external use only.
  • Stop if irritation occurs.
  • Keep away from children and pets.

Storage & Advice

  • Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
  • Keep sealed.
  • Avoid extreme temperatures.
  • Apply to pulse points for best results.

9143045095656.title: Crystal Glow Perfume
9143045095656.description:
Embrace the radiant brilliance of Crystal Glow, a fragrance that captures the essence of luminous elegance and sparkling sophistication. This enchanting perfume opens with a vibrant burst of citrus and juicy fruits, creating a bright, refreshing introduction that instantly lifts your spirit

At its heart, Crystal Glow blooms with a graceful bouquet of white florals and soft rose petals, adding a touch of delicate femininity and elegance. The floral notes dance gracefully, creating an aura of timeless beauty.As the fragrance settles, it melts into a warm, comforting base of amber, soft musk, and creamy vanilla, leaving a radiant, velvety trail that lingers elegantly on your skin.

Perfect for those who adore radiant, feminine fragrances, Crystal Glow is your ideal companion for sunny days, sparkling evenings, or any moment when you want to shine with a subtle, captivating glow.

Product Notes

    • Top Note: Cassis, White Peach, Mandarin, Bergamot.
    • Middle Note: Magnolia, Lily Of The Valley, Jasmine, Gardenia.
    • Base Note: Vanilla, Patchouli, White, Musk, Sanalwood, Amber Notes.

Product Description

    • Volume: 100 ml / 3.4 oz.
    • Fragrance Family: Fresh Citrus Aromatic

Lasting Hours

Fragrance duration may vary depending on application area and skin type. Typically lasts for 6–8 hours on the skin.

Safety Instructions

  • Avoid the eyes, face, and irritated skin.
  • Keep away from flames and heat.
  • For external use only.
  • Stop if irritation occurs.
  • Keep away from children and pets.

Storage & Advice

  • Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
  • Keep sealed.
  • Avoid extreme temperatures.
  • Apply to pulse points for best results.

Bold yet refined, it opens with the bright, zesty freshness of grapefruit, creating a crisp and uplifting first impression that feels clean, vibrant, and full of confidence.

9143622074600.title: Sugar Babe Body Mist
9143622074600.description:
Playful, addictive, and deliciously sweet—Sugar Babe is a body mist made for the bold and bubbly. This irresistibly fun fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruity notes wrapped in cozy vanilla, leading into a creamy woody heart that adds depth and warmth. As it dries down, it melts into a soft, comforting sweet-lactonic base that feels like a warm embrace. Perfect for those who love to stand out with a sweet signature scent, Sugar Babe is a celebration of charm, confidence, and unapologetic fun.

Product Notes

    • Top Note: Fruity, Vanilla.
    • Middle Note: Woody.
    • Base Note: Sweet, Lactonic

Product Description

    • Volume: 150 ml / 5.1 oz.
    • Fragrance Family: Fruity Floral

Lasting Hours

Fragrance duration may vary depending on application area and skin type. Typically lasts for 6–8 hours on the skin.

Safety Instructions

  • Avoid the eyes, face, and irritated skin.
  • Keep away from flames and heat.
  • For external use only.
  • Stop if irritation occurs.
  • Keep away from children and pets.

Storage & Advice

  • Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
  • Keep sealed.
  • Avoid extreme temperatures.
  • Apply to pulse points for best results.

9640543322344.title: Titanium Perfume
9640543322344.description:
Titanium is a unisex woody-aromatic perfume that captures freshness, strength, and modern confidence. It opens with a sharp burst of grapefruit, lemon, mint, and pink pepper, creating a crisp, energetic, and refreshing first impression.

At its heart, ginger and nutmeg add a warm spicy character, while jasmine brings a soft aromatic elegance. Iso E Super gives the fragrance a smooth, modern woody feel that makes it refined and long-lasting.

Fresh, woody, and powerful, Titanium is designed for both men and women, making it perfect for everyday wear, office settings, evenings, and moments when you want your fragrance to feel confident, modern, and unforgettable.

Product Notes

    • TOP NOTE Grapefruit, Lemon, Mint, Pink Pepper.
    • MIDDLE NOTE Ginger, Nutmeg, Jasmine, Iso E Super.
    • BASE NOTE Incense, Vetiver, Cedar, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Labdanum, White Musk

Product Description

    • Volume: 100 ml / 3.4 oz.
    • Scent Category: Woody-Aromatic

Lasting Hours

Fragrance duration may vary depending on application area and skin type. Typically lasts for 6–8 hours on the skin.

Safety Instructions

  • Avoid the eyes, face, and irritated skin.
  • Keep away from flames and heat.
  • For external use only.
  • Stop if irritation occurs.
  • Keep away from children and pets.

Storage & Advice

  • Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
  • Keep sealed.
  • Avoid extreme temperatures.
  • Apply to pulse points for best results.
